put.description: This operation consists of two requests. First call this endpoint with the Blob-* headers, without body to prepare the blob. Then call this endpoint without the Blob-* headers with a body to upload the file. The blob UUID must be generated client side.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the blob. This should be generated client side.

post.description: Get AccessToken: Provide an application token created in the current application. An access token is returned which can be used for the "AccessToken" header to execute connector requests. The 'scope' property is required in accountancy environments. When scope is not provided in accountancy environments, an identity token is returned which can be used in the 'ScopeSelection' api.
Get scopes: Provide an identity token returned by the 'AccessToken' api.
Get an access token for a scope.

bankaccount-1.0-Create-JsonSchema.description: Use this endpoint to create a new bankaccount data for a person or organisation.

RelationType.description: Must contain one of the enums. Will be required in a future version.

RelationId.description: Must contain the guid of the organisation or person. Will be required in a future version.

AccountNumber.description: Fill the IBAN code or AccountNumber

BankId.description: Fill the bankid. Also known as Bankcode of bank identifier.

AccountHolderName.description: Must contain the name of the account holder.

cashmutation-1.0-Create-JsonSchema.description: This endpoint allows you to add cash mutations directly from Point of Sale (POS) applications to the accounting software, streamlining the process of recording and managing cash transactions for businesses. For each cashmutation an request must be done.

administrationId.description: The Administration ID uniquely identifying an administration. Retrieve it from the endpoint: api/administration

description.description: The description providing information about the cash mutation and other bookings

date.description: The date when the cash mutation and other bookings occurred

ledgerAccountId.description: The Ledger Account ID uniquely identifying a ledger account. Retrieve it from the endpoint: api/ledgeraccounts

amountIncludingVat.description: The amount including VAT for the cash mutation and other bookings

vatPercentage.description: The percentage of VAT applied to the cash mutation and other bookings

vatType.description: The type of VAT operation - 'purchase' or 'sales'

attachments.description: Use the blob endpoint to create a Attachment. Fill the guid of the attachment.
